name: ESPACIO The Jewel of Waikiki
insider_take: This ultra-luxury tower rises 400 feet above Waikiki, offering an exclusive residential-style experience with only 9 units per floor and breathtaking panoramic views of Diamond Head, the Pacific Ocean, and Honolulu's skyline.
whats_special: ESPACIO features the largest residential-style suites in Waikiki, each spanning 1,200+ square feet with floor-to-ceiling windows and private lanais. The building's innovative design includes a sky deck on the 41st floor - one of the highest outdoor spaces in all of Hawaii - plus a unique "missing" 13th floor that creates dramatic double-height ceilings for select suites.
pro_tip: Book a Diamond Head-facing suite for sunrise views and request access to the exclusive 41st-floor sky deck during golden hour - it's one of the most Instagram-worthy spots in Waikiki with virtually no crowds.
dont_miss: The rooftop infinity pool seems to merge with the Pacific horizon, while the ground-floor luxury retail corridor connects directly to the Royal Hawaiian Center. Take advantage of the concierge's insider access to private beach cabanas at nearby luxury resorts that aren't available to regular hotel guests.
pros: Prime Waikiki Beach location with direct beach access
Luxury boutique property with exclusive amenities
Spacious suites with premium furnishings and ocean views
Personalized concierge services and VIP treatment
cons: Limited dining options within the property
